Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem

$outDir = 'C:\\Users\\aaron\\Documents\\cradlemod\\build\\tmp\\api_inspect2'

# Find common JAR
$commonJar = Get-ChildItem 'C:\\Users\\aaron\\.gradle\\caches\\fabric-loom\\minecraftMaven\\net\\minecraft\\minecraft-common\\1.21.11-loom.mappings.1_21_11.layered+hash.2198-v2\\' -Filter '*.jar' | Select-Object -First 1
Write-Host "Common JAR: $\($commonJar.FullName\)"

# Find client JAR

Write-Host "Client JAR: $\($clientJar.FullName\)"

# Extract ResourceLocation from common JAR
$zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead\($commonJar.FullName\)
$entry = $zip.Entries | Where-Object { $_.FullName -eq 'net/minecraft/resources/ResourceLocation.class' }
if \($entry\) {
    $stream = $entry.Open\(\)
    $fileStream = [System.IO.File]::Create\("$outDir\\ResourceLocation.class"\)
    $stream.CopyTo\($fileStream\)
    $fileStream.Close\(\)
    $stream.Close\(\)
    Write-Host "Extracted ResourceLocation.class"
} else {
    Write-Host "ResourceLocation.class NOT FOUND in common JAR"
    # Search for it
    $zip.Entries | Where-Object { $_.FullName -like '*ResourceLocation*' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  Found: $\($_.FullName\)" }
}
$zip.Dispose\(\)

# Extract Minecraft.class and KeyMapping.class from client JAR
$zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead\($clientJar.FullName\)

$mc = $zip.Entries | Where-Object { $_.FullName -eq 'net/minecraft/client/Minecraft.class' }
if \($mc\) {
    $stream = $mc.Open\(\)
    $fileStream = [System.IO.File]::Create\("$outDir\\Minecraft.class"\)
    $stream.CopyTo\($fileStream\)
    $fileStream.Close\(\)
    $stream.Close\(\)
    Write-Host "Extracted Minecraft.class"
} else {
    Write-Host "Minecraft.class NOT FOUND"
}

# Search for KeyMapping
$keyEntries = $zip.Entries | Where-Object { $_.FullName -like '*KeyMapping*' -and $_.FullName -notlike '*$*' }
foreach \($e in $keyEntries\) {
    Write-Host "Found KeyMapping: $\($e.FullName\)"

    $stream = $e.Open\(\)
    $fileStream = [System.IO.File]::Create\("$outDir\\$name"\)
    $stream.CopyTo\($fileStream\)
    $fileStream.Close\(\)
    $stream.Close\(\)
    Write-Host "Extracted $name"
}
